title: Create queued DatabaseService for SQLite writes — single writer with ordered queue
objective: Replace direct openIndexDatabase concurrent writes from Node Control API and Filesystem/Index Watcher with a single DatabaseService that queues all SQLite writes in order with BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, eliminating UNIQUE constraint failed: files.path and database access denied errors. Reads remain parallel via WAL.
acceptance_criteria: Create src/infrastructure/sqlite/database-service.js exposing createDatabaseService({ dataDir, busyTimeoutMs, journalMode }) with methods write(sql, params), read(sql, params), transaction(fn), close() — write queue is FIFO with BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> COMMIT/ROLLBACK, busy_timeout and journal_mode=WAL set on open

Refactor eventStore, historyStore, sessionStore, roadmapStore, sprintPlanProjection, ticketProvenanceTracker, incrementalIndexer, indexMetadata to accept databaseService instead of raw database, and use service.write/read; no direct openIndexDatabase write outside service

Writes from Node server (agent profiles, secrets metadata, communication/history, event store, sessions, roadmap) and Watcher (files, symbols, imports/exports, calls/dependency edges, index metadata, watcher/verification events) all go through service queue; concurrent writes no longer cause UNIQUE constraint failed: files.path
Duplicate file path handled via INSERT OR REPLACE / ON CONFLICT upsert in service layer, verified by concurrent write test
Service survives restart: after npm run dev:forge:stop/start, GET /projects/PROJECT-114A/history still shows events and database not locked

Tests PASS: node --test tests/unit/index-database.test.js tests/unit/event-store.test.js tests/integration/persistent-event-store.test.js, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run validate:schemas, git diff --check; manual smoke: parallel POST /tasks triggers concurrent file writes without UNIQUE error and tail .node-control/logs/node.log shows no database access denied
